title: Pool protocol v1 class advertisement state (GET /pool/classes response)
description: Response body of GET /pool/classes: the coordinator's computed cross-member class advertisement state (D-C1, D-C3). Metadata only, no prompt/response content (anti-memory).

classes.description: One entry per class with at least one loaded member (D-C1). A class with no loaded member is absent from the list, not listed with a zero count.

member_count.description: Loaded members across all connected routers (D-C1). Exclusion marks do not reduce this count (D-F1 is a per-user dispatch preference, not membership).

advertised_ctx.description: The context the router advertises for this class: min(average + std_dev, max) across loaded members (D-C3); a coordinator config option selects max instead.

min_ctx.description: Smallest member context in the class.

max_ctx.description: Largest member context in the class.
